caption: The drawing displays five objects arranged on a beige background. At the top left, there is a mauve or dusty rose colored women's jacket with a fitted waist, flaring slightly at the hips, and long sleeves, featuring cuffs and a collar made of floral-patterned fabric in darker colors, possibly black or brown with red and green accents. The jacket is fastened with a single row of buttons down the center front. Directly to the right of the jacket, and centrally placed, is a muff (handwarmer) covered in the same dark, floral-patterned fabric as the jacket's cuffs and collar, with the sides trimmed in matching mauve fabric. To the right of the muff, there is a full-length dress in the same mauve color as the jacket, with a fitted bodice, full skirt, and decorative ruffles and gathers. The front panel, as well as a section over the right hip and down the skirt, are made of the dark floral-patterned fabric matching the other objects. In the lower left corner of the composition is a square swatch of the same floral fabric, showing a repeating pattern of red and pink flowers with green leaves on a dark background. In the bottom right corner, there is a small label bearing the word “Document.”
title: Gown, Coat, and Muff
